title: Mouse digestive and conduit teaching extension
authorship: Original procedural teaching geometry authored for Animal Atlas; no external mesh copied
licenseScope: New authored geometry and scripts; source Digimouse remains under its original CC BY-SA license. Anatomy reference figures were consulted for factual morphology only; no reference images or external meshes are reproduced.

sources.title: Margaret J. Cook, The Anatomy of the Laboratory Mouse: abdominal viscera in situ
INHAND rodent gastrointestinal nomenclature and morphology

coordinateSystem: Source raw millimetres; head toward decreasing Y, ventral toward decreasing Z. No verified left/right labeling.
limitations: Teaching approximation, not CT-derived segmentation or verified registration.
Loop number, lumen calibre, total bowel length and segment boundaries are illustrative, not specimen measurements.
No intestinal villi, haustra, taenia coli, appendix or separate histological layers are modeled.
Source organ meshes are read for anchoring and remain unchanged.
Caecum and ileum/colon meet by small overlapping closed surfaces; lumen flow continuity is conceptual, not surgical/manufacturing grade.
